subject: MAP draft + target close alignment / procurement signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Keller <alex.keller@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps (post-call recap)

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) outlining milestones, owners, and proposed dates to hit your target go-live. High level notes:  

- Target close (contract signed): 2026-07-15 (internal target)  
- Procurement/Legal signature target: 2026-07-30 (to allow your internal PO and SOC review)  
- Key milestones: technical POC (by 2026-06-25), security questionnaire completed (by 2026-06-30), pilot config & benchmark (by 2026-07-08), contract review (by 2026-07-12).  
- Responsibilities: FintechCo owners in column B; Redwood owners (Camila = account lead, Aditya = solutions engineer) in column C.  
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence access, SSO config window, and procurement review cycles noted in yellow in the sheet.  

Please review the MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and let us know any date conflicts or additional stakeholders we should loop in. If the target close needs to shift, flag the items that become critical. Next step from our side: we can produce an updated MAP with your procurement deadlines by EOD Friday if you confirm constraints.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Alex Keller <alex.keller@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechco.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear MAP. A couple of notes from our side after syncing with procurement/legal:  

1) Procurement has a sprint of vendor assessments that pushes signature milestones out ~2 weeks unless we submit evidence this week. The soonest procurement signature they can commit to today is 2026-08-05.  
2) Legal indicated they want a single redlined SOW rather than multiple round trips; Priya (cc) will own the redlines.  
3) We need the SOC 2 artifact links and a short note on data retention by EOD Friday to accelerate procurement review.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to the updated procurement signature target (2026-08-05) and provide the SOC 2 link and retention summary? If pushing to Aug 5 changes any of your internal delivery commitments, flag those in a revised MAP.

—Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
FintechCo
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Keller <alex.keller@fintechco.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (post-call recap)

Alex / Priya — thanks for the update. Quick replies to your asks:  

- SOC 2 report (read-only) and our security evidence bundle: https://redwood-share.example.com/soc2/2026 (link shared with your security inbox).  
- Data retention: standard retention is 30 days for request logs, 90 days for inference telemetry; we can discuss contractual exceptions in the SOW. Short summary included in the updated MAP.  

We can absolutely adjust the MAP to reflect procurement signature = 2026-08-05. That shifts the contract review milestone and pushes pilot benchmark by ~1 week; no change to engineering delivery SLAs on our side. I've attached an updated MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.1.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW_Draft.pdf) for Priya's redlines.

If Priya can consolidate legal comments into a single tracked SOW, we will route for an internal counter-signature and prepare a DocuSign envelope once redlines are agreed.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.1.xlsx; SOW_Draft.pdf
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Alex Keller <alex.keller@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (post-call recap)

Camila — thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the updated MAP and SOW. A few quick asks:  

- Please add a clear sign-off owner for the SOC 2 evidence (we need a point of contact for security follow-ups).  
- Can you add a procurement step that includes a 5-business-day internal PO approval window after legal signs? That will help us sequence budget approvals.  
- We will submit redlines by 2026-06-15; please plan to respond within 3 business days so we can keep the Aug 5 signature target.

If Redwood confirms the SOC 2 contact and the 5-day PO window in the MAP, we will proceed with internal routing this week.

Best,
Priya Shah
Sr. Procurement Manager
FintechCo
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechco.com>, Alex Keller <alex.keller@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (post-call recap)

Priya / Alex — thanks, all. Confirming the adjustments and next steps:  

- SOC 2 point of contact: Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwood.ai) — security evidence triage and follow-ups.  
- Added procurement step: 5 business day PO approval window after legal sign-off (added into MAP milestone row).  
- Redwood will review legal redlines and respond within 3 business days of receipt (we'll triage with legal and product ops).  
- Updated target dates: procurement signature = 2026-08-05; contract signed (mutual signature) by 2026-07-22 to allow procurement window (MAP shows both dates for clarity).  

I've attached the MAP with those two edits (Redwood_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and will open a DocuSign envelope once SOW redlines are returned and accepted. If that timeline works, please confirm and we'll mark milestones in HubSpot.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the line.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.2.xlsx
DocuSign (to be created after legal sign-off)
